SEO vs Google Ads: which is better for a small business?

Ava Digital · Updated 2026 · ~4 min read
Short answer: They solve different problems. Google Ads gives you instant leads you pay for per click. SEO is slower but compounds into “free,” lasting traffic. Most small businesses should run Ads now and build SEO for the long term.

How each one works

Google Ads puts you at the top of results immediately — you pay each time someone clicks. Turn it off and the traffic stops. SEO earns rankings over months; once you’re there, the clicks are free and keep coming.

The honest trade-offs

  • Speed: Ads win — leads in days. SEO takes months.
  • Cost over time: SEO wins — cost per lead drops as it compounds; ads cost the same per click forever.
  • Sustainability: SEO wins — it keeps working after you stop paying.
  • Trust: SEO wins — many people skip ads and click organic results.

Why the real answer is usually “both”

Run Ads to fill your pipeline today while SEO builds the compounding asset for tomorrow. Ads also reveal which keywords actually convert — data that makes your SEO smarter.
